decisions.module_registry: New assets/js/modules.js owns module state. localStorage key alexandria-modules:v1. Subject order vision→bets→guardrails→vocabulary→user-research. Banking unlocks the next-in-line. Fires document module:banked event for listeners.
decisions.postmessage_protocol: Vision Builder's Bank button posts { type: alexandria.bankVision, payload } to window.parent when embedded. Standalone mode shows an alert with a sketch of what the embed would do.
decisions.celebration_beat: vision-embed.js shows a full-viewport overlay (#vision-bank-beat) with ✦ glyph + Bridget atomizing copy + 3-dot spinner. 2.4s display, 0.4s fade.
decisions.post_bank_intro: After beat, iframe unmounts and render1_4 re-fires. The render is now status-aware: if Vision is banked, it shows Bets-is-next copy + Level 1 of Raven 1/5 banked.
decisions.kb_active_subject: body[data-active-subject=<id>] drives which KB row pulses + accepts clicks. Plus body.subject-banked-<id> drives the settled treatment. Both maintained by modules.js syncBodyActive.
decisions.info_hub_sync: New assets/js/info-hub-sync.js. Doesn't touch product-library.js — uses a MutationObserver on #by-status-view to detect when the board renders, then patches the DOM directly to move/add module cards into the correct lane. Removes mock dupes by title-match.
decisions.library_sync: New assets/js/library-sync.js. On module:banked, builds a vision-statement card with stitched body (slot title + Build/Tune/Approved label + answer + scratch), inserts/replaces in window.RAVEN_LIBRARY_DATA.cards under rationale/product-theses, calls ravenInitConstellation+ravenInitFolders to re-render if available.
decisions.subject_stub: Clicking the active subject in KB when it's not Vision (i.e., Bets after Vision banks) shows a coming-soon view in tfs-body — honest about what's built vs not.

note: Vision phase wired end-to-end for Raven CLI participation. Canvas-server has vision state + endpoints + SSE; Vision Builder has Sources panel + SSE subscriber + remote-write applier; canvasdemo skill has Beat 5; new raven/vision-drafting sub-skill ships the procedure. Server kept restarted clean.

decisions.server_state_file: docs/alexandria/.canvas-state/vision.json keyed by slot id (1, 2, 3a, 3b, 4-8) with {text, scratch, notch, lastWritten:{ts,by}} plus sources[] and banked flag.
decisions.new_endpoints: GET /api/canvas/vision; POST /api/canvas/vision/slot/:id, /scratch/:id, /notch/:id (each with by: director|raven); POST /api/canvas/vision/sources; POST /api/canvas/vision/bank; POST /api/canvas/vision/reset; GET /api/vision-stream (dedicated SSE pool).
decisions.wake_events: vision-sources-handed (emitted on POST sources, payload includes count and by); vision-banked (emitted on POST bank). Both append to step-events.jsonl so the existing canvas-watcher.sh Stop-hook picks them up.
decisions.sources_panel: Top band on the Vision Builder, paste-in textarea (one source per line), Hand to Raven button → POST /api/canvas/vision/sources, source chips render below with author tags. Panel auto-hides until server detected; can be collapsed once handed.
decisions.sse_apply: Vision Builder subscribes to /api/vision-stream on boot when server is reachable. mergeRemoteState applies remote writes to local state + DOM without full re-render (preserves cursor positions). remote-flash class on the section gives a brief amber pulse when Raven writes.
decisions.notch_rule_per_director: Director ratified: Raven sets slot to Build only if her draft is truly blank. Slots with drafted content keep notch at 0 (unset) so the director decides. Codified in raven/vision-drafting.md.
decisions.drafting_mode: One-shot fill, post-completion (not slot-by-slot). Per Danvers's ratification of Phase 2.D plan guidance.
decisions.scratchpad_only_for_confidence: Raven writes confidence flags + conflicts ONLY into scratch fields, never into slot text. Per Danvers's ratification.
decisions.example_button_rename: Load Alexandria example → Load Alexandria sample (testing) — once Raven can really draft, the static example is testing-only.
decisions.skill_delegation: Sonnet sub-agent drafted raven/vision-drafting.md (325 lines, end-to-end procedure including failure modes for 404s, empty source lists, sparse material, cross-source contradictions). I authored Beat 5 in canvasdemo/SKILL.md.
